links.outcome: Reading grade level of original orthopaedic discharge instructions versus target sixth-grade level
links.effect: Original instructions averaged grade 9.8; after ChatGPT rewriting 7.5, and not all documents reached the desired sixth-grade level.
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly reduced the average reading grade level of discharge instructions from 9.8 to 7.5 across all content categories (P < .001).

links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of original versus ChatGPT plain-language rewritten discharge instructions
links.effect: Understandability rose from 63.6% to 87.9% (P < .001); actionability from 44.4% to 73.6% (P < .001); grade level fell from 9.8 to 7.5.
links.quote: Understandability and actionability scores improved from 63.6% to 87.9% (P < .001) and from 44.4% to 73.6%, respectively (P < .001).

unlisted_practices: Using generative AI to rewrite existing patient discharge instructions with structured prompting

screen.reason: The study evaluates an LLM (ChatGPT-4) for rewriting postoperative discharge instructions to improve readability, understandability, and actionability, but evaluates the model's performance directly rather than testing a specific implementation or governance safeguard practice.
